remaining.what: After a return whose re-entry week was neither finished nor reviewed, any unrelated decision dated from that week's last day on and before a separate later break (an equipment statement, even one that changes nothing, or a systemic-fatigue report) makes stateAtBreak's earned-week predicate accept the week start the return stored, so the later break starts from a return step never executed (P30c: week 6 runs 30/45 instead of 15/20; week 7 back-squat 2x5@3 KNOWN 82.5 instead of the 1x5@4 entry, long 60 instead of 45; P30b: 13 of 15 cells change the start, 7 advance the run return step)
remaining.cause: src/r6-adaptation.mjs:674: earned(k) counts any decision with fromWeek <= k dated on or after the last day of week k-1; a decision made in week k keeps week k's start and never re-derives it from week k-1's evidence
